arguments.summary: An investigation into a suspected APT-29 campaign was initiated following the identification of external C2 IP 203.0.113.88. Initial IOC lookups revealed prior low-severity port scan alerts from this IP targeting a low-criticality IT asset (WS-IT-101). Subsequent EDR queries on affected engineering hosts (WS-ENG-015, SRV-BUILD-01) showed no malicious process trees or suspicious network connections. Full EPP scans returned clean results. SIEM analysis showed no direct logs linking the C2 IP to internal compromised hosts. The sandbox analysis of a related payload hash (ba5bada8) returned a 'clean' verdict. The incident remains under investigation, but no confirmed compromise has been found on the primary targets. Key detection gaps were identified in monitoring for encrypted C2 traffic and credential-based lateral movement.

timeline.description: External IDS alert (IDS-2026-03200) triggered by IP 203.0.113.88 performing a port scan on WS-IT-101. Alert severity was low and action was logged.
Normal authentication event from WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15) to domain controller (10.0.1.1) by user CORP\helpdesk.
Incident response initiated. IOC lookup on 203.0.113.88 confirmed prior scan activity.
EDR queries on WS-ENG-015 and SRV-BUILD-01 showed no suspicious processes or network connections.
SIEM search for C2 IP and host activity returned no relevant events for engineering hosts. Full EPP scan on WS-ENG-015 completed with no threats found.
Sandbox analysis of payload hash ba5bada8 returned a clean verdict with a low risk score.
